author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A drive-through collection at Manchester’s Stark Park will gather food and personal-care supplies for the Webster Elementary School pantry on Saturday, September 12. The event is scheduled from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at 550 River Road.

Ward 1 school board member Julie Turner and Alderman Bryce Kaw-uh are organizing the second annual drive. The pantry opened at Webster Elementary in 2024 with support from a local Hannaford supermarket, and last year’s collection was created to help refill its shelves.

Organizers are requesting soap, toothpaste, shampoo, rice, pasta, spaghetti sauce, cereal, canned vegetables and fruit, beans, macaroni and cheese, and individually packaged foods such as granola bars. The broad list is designed to support both household meals and items students can use easily.

Manchester Ink Link reported that families experiencing food insecurity can contact their school social worker for help connecting with food resources. Families may also apply online for free or reduced-price school meals. The collection gives residents a direct way to support a school-based resource before the academic year moves deeper into fall.
dek: Manchester residents can bring food and hygiene supplies to a drive-through collection at Stark Park from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. September 12.
headline: Stark Park drive will restock Webster Elementary food pantry Saturday
